title: Existing daily news briefing with bounded deterministic retrieval

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Resolve actual capable worker bridge; exhausted Desktop Commander remains unavailable despite recovered native invocation policy.
Use existing news_check.py with actual UTC request ID, fresh Eastern business date, approved sources and encrypted state.
Cover major US/world, economy/markets, AI/education and what matters today; connect relevant AI/education trends to the book and its AI chapter.
Exclude personal finance, debt, balances, retirement allocation and personalized financial implications; those stay in separate restricted finance runs.
Review current official Delaware executive/legislative developments against private civic priorities, distinguishing active decisions from actions already taken.
Identify relevant officials/bodies and practical lawful constituent actions without sending contacts; source links and active-decision status need current evidence.
Feed metadata completeness is not major-news, civic-action or book-trend completeness; preserve judgment checks and named fallback coverage.
Use broad bound calendar discovery plus durable gift-history and prior confirmed family evidence; missing confirmed records remain holds, not silently dropped people.
Only upcoming confirmed-family birthdays within 30 days or confirmed recipients missing history records may appear; omit covered, recorded-past and unrelated calendar entries.
Retain News 21-day selection and 7-day price/availability/staging intent; cart staging is a separate authenticated authorized action and no order follows without explicit approval.
This bounded review grants no cart action. If browser staging is unavailable, report ready for the browser step rather than claim it was added.
Only acknowledge exact final output after destination readback; local packet acknowledgement never proves cloud/user delivery.

success_checks: Brief covers original news/civic/book-trend scope with current source links and explicit coverage gaps, excluding all personal financial content.
Gift section respects confirmed-family, upcoming/missing-record and covered-gift rules; no duplicate action or claimed staging without actual evidence.
Task destination matches actual final text and private packet acknowledgement; unacknowledged headlines remain eligible.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
